[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-aq[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Keyed `{@<id>}` agent-name markers for xprompt swarms[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every `@` reference inside one xprompt swarm launch resolves to the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same concrete agent-name token, chosen once per launch and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]substituted into the prompt text before any agent spawns, so a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]later swarm launch can never steal an earlier swarm's hood.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]agent_name_key_markers.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-aq[/#87AFFF]

[dim]         [bold #87AFFF][/dim]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keyed marker grammar in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: teach `sase_core::agent_name_template` the `{@<id>}` / [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`{@<id>!}` marker, add a lexical marker scanner and key accessor, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expose both through the `sase_core_py` bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python facade and prompt-grammar plumbing[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]facade[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]facade: wrap the new Rust entry points in `sase.agent.names`, widen the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directive and xprompt argument character classes so braced markers [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]survive parsing, and bump the `sase-core-rs` requirement window.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Launch-time key resolution and text substitution[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]resolve[dim] · [dim][/dim]after facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]resolve: add a keyed marker resolver that allocates one token per key [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under the agent-name lock and rewrites every occurrence in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatch's segment text, wire it into the launch funnel, and reject [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]markers that reach a runner.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-invocation key qualification at swarm expansion[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]qualify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after resolve[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]qualify: rewrite unqualified `{@<id>}` markers to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`{@<xprompt>.<stamp>.<id>!}` while expanding an xprompt swarm so each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]invocation gets its own key space, leaving `!` markers untouched.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Migrate existing xprompt swarms[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]migrate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after qualify[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]migrate: convert the bare `@` markers in this repo's `reads` swarm and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the chezmoi `research_swarm` swarm to the keyed syntax, including the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prose references.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the keyed marker syntax[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
